summary.text: J.B. Jennings is the Republican state senator for Maryland District 7, in office since January 2011, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A pilot and dairy farmer, he served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2002 to 2010.

paragraphs.text: Jennings earned an associate degree from Essex Community College in 1995 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Baltimore in 1997, and he served in the U.S. Air National Guard.

His professional experience includes working as co-owner and president of The Mill of Hereford, as a volunteer firefighter with the Jacksonville Volunteer Fire Company, and as a dairy farmer with Cedar Side Farm.
Jennings served in the House of Delegates from 2002 to 2010 and took his Senate seat on January 12, 2011.
In the 2025-2026 term he serves on the Budget & Taxation and Rules committees, among others.
